title: tc-tool-call-card
description: One tool call of an AI agent: name, summary, status with a live timer, arguments and result.

name.description: Tool name as the agent calls it, shown in mono – e.g. "search_web"

status.description: "running" shows a spinner and a live timer, "success" a check and the duration, "error" "Failed" and the message

args.description: Arguments the tool was called with – objects are pretty-printed, JSON strings parsed

result.description: What the tool returned – objects are pretty-printed, JSON strings parsed, other text shown as is

error.description: Error message, shown when status is "error"

startedAt.description: When the call started (ms since epoch) – the live timer counts from here

duration.description: Final duration in ms – otherwise measured while the card shows "running"

open.description: Expanded. Changed by the user (and on an error) unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

openOnError.description: Opens the card when the call fails and closes it again on the next run, unless someone toggled it

maxCodeHeight.description: Height in px after which arguments and result are capped with a fade and "Show all"
